name: 5 Mistakes That Changed History
description: Historian and comedian Paul Coulter presents a storytelling/comedy show about five mistakes that changed history. Theatre Severn lists the show for Sunday 27 September at 19:30.

name: Bayston Hill Library Stories and Rhymes
description: Free monthly 30-minute session for pre-school children mixing stories, songs and rhymes with a simple craft. Further confirmed dates are 3 November and 1 December 2026.
accessibility: Bayston Hill Library is autism friendly and has level-entry access. The official library page notes there are no toilet facilities.

name: Girls Youth Group – Craven Arms
description: Free fortnightly youth group for girls aged 9–14. Confirmed sessions include 25 September (giant bubbles and animal balloons), 9 October (willow tray) and 23 October (hot dog mummies and fingers). Supported by Craven Arms Association of Youth Groups; volunteers are DBS checked and safeguarding trained.

name: ROXY MAGIC – Roxy Music Tribute – 30 October
description: Roxy Music and Bryan Ferry tribute ROXY MAGIC at Theatre on the Steps. Official venue listing confirms Friday 30 October at 20:00.

name: One Chance – Loppington Village Hall
description: Community cinema screening of One Chance, the Paul Potts biopic. Arts Alive confirms Tuesday 29 September at 19:30 at Loppington Village Hall and states that a bar is available. No ticket price has been recorded because it was not exposed in the verified listing.
source_name: Arts Alive / Flicks in the Sticks

name: The Grange Youth Club – 16 September
description: Free Young Shrewsbury youth-club session. The council’s current Million Hours youth programme is aimed at ages 12–18 and includes sports, creative sessions, social activities and wellbeing support. Parent/guardian registration form applies to youth-club attendance.
age_guidance: Young Shrewsbury programme page states ages 12–18

name: Much Wenlock Library Rhyme Time
description: Free sing-along nursery-rhyme session with actions. Current official dates include 1 October, 5 November and 3 December 2026, plus 8 January 2027.
accessibility: Much Wenlock Library is listed by Shropshire Council as autism friendly, with disabled parking and level-entry access.
age_guidance: Age guidance not stated on official event page

name: The Devil Wears Prada 2 – Ackleton Village Hall
description: ‘Prada and Prosecco’ community screening of The Devil Wears Prada 2. Arts Alive confirms Saturday 17 October at 19:00, doors 18:30; £10 includes nibbles and a glass of something chilled. Door sales are listed.
source_name: Arts Alive / Flicks in the Sticks

name: Song Sung Blue – Tasley Parish Room
description: Community screening of the 12A musical drama Song Sung Blue. Arts Alive confirms Saturday 3 October at 19:45, tickets £5. An optional fish-and-chips meal is available separately by advance arrangement.
source_name: Arts Alive / Flicks in the Sticks

name: Song Sung Blue – Bedstone & Hopton Castle Village Hall
description: Community screening of the 12A musical drama Song Sung Blue. Arts Alive confirms Friday 16 October at 19:30, with cabaret seating, bring-your-own beer/wine and interval refreshments.
source_name: Arts Alive / Flicks in the Sticks
